objective: Targeted strengthening of credit_card_engine interest/fee behavior (C42.21: 582 generated, 440 killed, 142 survived, 75.6%). C42.22 estimated ~26 genuine Class-A interest/fee candidates; verified against actual survivors rather than blindly adding 26 tests.
strategic_constraint: Strengthen genuine financial behavior only; do not add tests solely to kill equivalent arithmetic mutants.
approach: Added 9 deterministic tests for the interest module (interest.py): 365-day Indian daily-rate convention, exact ROUND_HALF_EVEN daily accrual, zero short-circuits, ValueError guards on negative inputs, monthly aggregation, and invalid-cycle guards. Targets the interest/fee Class-A inventory from C42.21/22.

validation.targeted_mutation: Manual mutant (3650000 -> 3600000 denominator) caught by test_bps_to_daily_rate_uses_365_day_year (test FAILS on mutant).
validation.method_note: Full component re-measurement is performed by the authoritative CI campaign (Batch 6 trigger).

survivor_classification.class_A_addressed: Interest accrual exact value, 365-day convention, rounding mode, guard ValueError semantics.
survivor_classification.class_B: Equivalent arithmetic mutations on fee aggregation paths whose valid-domain result is unchanged.
